speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. To help narrow down the cause of your symptoms, can you describe the specific location and nature of your abdominal pain? Also, have you experienced any changes in your bowel habits or noticed any blood in your stool?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling very tired and have had worsening abdominal pain for about four weeks. I have also had drenching night sweats and lost about twelve pounds.

speaker: Doctor
text: To better assess the severity of your condition, could you quantify your weight loss by telling me your approximate weight at the onset of symptoms versus now? Additionally, have you noticed any other swollen lymph nodes in your neck, armpits, or groin, or experienced any persistent fever?

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a history of tuberculosis exposure or recent travel to an endemic area? Also, have you experienced any persistent cough or shortness of breath?

speaker: Patient
text: I also feel fullness in my abdomen and my clothes feel tighter. I do not have cough or recent travel.

speaker: Doctor
text: Have you experienced any unexplained itching or noticed pain in your lymph nodes after drinking alcohol? REQUEST TEST: CT_Scan_Abdomen_Pelvis

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have a family history of cancer, and have you noticed any itching on your skin? REQUEST TEST: Excisional_Lymph_Node_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Lymphocytes with a high proliferative index that stain positive for CD20.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the CD20 positivity and high proliferative index, this strongly suggests a B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma, such as diffuse large B-cell lymphoma. DIAGNOSIS READY: Diffuse Large B-Cell Lymphoma
